DeployBot: Starting pipeline for tag v2.8.0-rc3 on staging
env: staging

change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC
Release notes: https://redwood.co/rel/2.8.0-rc3

CI Bot: build passed (kubebuild-42) :white_check_mark:

CI Bot: lint failed (eslint) — see snippet below
```
/path/to/repo/src/runtime/kv_client.ts:118:5
  118 |   const value = cache?.get(key)
       |                 ^ Unexpected token
  119 |   if (!value) return null
```

Cheng Li: ugh the eslint rule from shared-config v5.2 triggered. I can pin @rw/shared-config to v5.1 and rerun. Thoughts?

Priya Sen: FYI embedder-suite was flaky in yesterday's run. Pinning might avoid the new rule break, but check TS/ES target mismatch too.

Maya Nguyen: @Cheng can we hotfix the linter change without delaying the release? Change window is 02:00-04:00 UTC, it's 21:40 UTC now.

Cheng Li: we can create rc3-lint-pin branch that pins @rw/shared-config@5.1 in package.json and run a lint-only pipeline. Quick and reversible.

CI Bot: lint rerun queued (job 789).

CI Bot: lint rerun failed again — different file this time. Output:
```
eslint error: Unexpected token '?.' at src/runtime/kv_client.ts:122
```

Priya Sen: That optional chaining token points to a TS config or typescript version mismatch. Did lint runner use the repo tsconfig? Could be the build image using older node/typescript.

Cheng Li: I can either bump tsconfig target to es2020 in the lint runner or pin typescript to 4.9. Pin is fastest. I'll try that in the hotfix branch.

Maya Nguyen: Decision time — rollforward with a pin (patch now) or hold and wait for full upstream fix. Prefer rollforward if it doesn't break tests. @Priya any QA blockers?

Priya Sen: QA note: unit + integration passed earlier but embedder-suite flaked twice. If we rollforward with eslint + typescript pin, QA will approve provided we run a post-deploy smoke and monitor.

Maya Nguyen: OK decision: create hotfix branch with @rw/shared-config@5.1 and typescript@4.9, run lint-only, then full pipeline. If lint-only green, run full. @Cheng please open PR and link.

Cheng Li: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/7423 — running lint-only. cc @Maya @Priya

CI Bot: lint-only passed :white_check_mark: (job 789)
Next: full pipeline queued.

DeployBot: Full pipeline started (job 790) — build -> test -> integration. commit 9f3b7a2 -> patched commit 9f3b7a2-patch1

CI Bot: integration tests running... (embedder-suite queued)

CI Bot: integration tests reported 1 flaky failure in embedder-suite (attempt 1/3).

Priya Sen: Note: our policy is auto-rollback if embedder-suite fails 3/3. For now let it retry (attempts allowed = 3).

CI Bot: embedder-suite passed on retry (attempt 2/3) :white_check_mark:

Maya Nguyen: Good. Post-deploy smoke scheduled in 30m. Release notes updated with the pin rationale: https://redwood.co/rel/2.8.0-rc3/notes

Cheng Li: :thumbsup: Patch merged and deployment continuing.

DeployBot: Staging deploy finished successfully :tada: env=staging commit=9f3b7a2-patch1 duration=12m
